components.name: Chart/Model comparison
components.description: Compares 2–4 AI models (or vendors, prompts) across the metrics that matter, all normalised to 0–100 where higher is better. One row per metric, one dot per model, best value printed. Invert costs and latency before plotting and say so in the caption. React: <ModelComparison models metrics={[{ label, scores: [] }]} />
